verdict.rationale: Authy documents on-device token generation and code access without internet on the phone, so the offline half of the story is covered. However, the evidence shows Authy is built around a phone-number-tied account with SMS/voice device registration, which contradicts the 'no vendor account required' half. Missing for 10: no-account usage (Authy requires a phone-number-based account), independent hands-on confirmation of fully offline operation including desktop.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: You can still access secured websites without internet access on your phone.
